question: The Yaoshang festival of Manipur is celebrated for ______ days.
solution:
The correct answer is __**five.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Yaoshang festival of Manipur** is celebrated for **five days.**
 
• It is the biggest and most **popular festival of Manipur, **celebrated in the month of** March.**
 
• The festival marks the **arrival of spring** and is celebrated with great enthusiasm and joy.
 
• During the festival, people of Manipur play with **colors, sing and dance, and exchange gifts and greetings.**
 
• The festival also has religious significance, as people offer prayers to** Lord Krishna and seek his blessings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Yaoshang festival is also known as the **Holi festival of Manipur.**
 
• It is celebrated by the **Meitei community of Manipur.**
 
• The festival is a symbol of **unity and brotherhood **among the people of Manipur. 
 
• The festival is celebrated with** traditional rituals, cultural programs, and sports activities.**
 
• The festival also includes the **Thabal Chongba dance**, which is a popular dance form of Manipur.
